tasks.name: Shift tap recognition
tasks.description: shift_tap.lua: a pure observe(down, key, now) that tells a lone Shift tap from Shift used as a modifier.
acceptance: lua tests/test_shift_tap.lua passes every assertion
A tap is a press and release of the same Shift less than 500 ms apart with no other key between; a chord with Control, Alt or Super, or a longer hold, is not
With no clock, any hold counts
The module is pure: no state, no clock read, no rime global

tasks.name: Enter on a draft with no Chinese
tasks.description: decide gains draft_ascii: Enter in idle on a draft with no Chinese commits it as is.
acceptance: lua tests/test_decide.lua passes every assertion
Enter in idle on a non-empty draft with no byte >= 0x80 is commit_draft, with no backend call
With draft_ascii omitted or false, every earlier decision is unchanged

tasks.name: The raw candidate
tasks.description: ime_translate_raw.lua: in English mode, a raw segment gets the typed text as its only candidate.
acceptance: lua tests/test_raw.lua and lua tests/test_glue_load.lua pass
Only a raw segment in English mode gets a candidate: the typed text, spanning the segment
Chinese mode is unchanged: fallback_segmentor's raw leftovers get nothing
Loads headless: no rime global is touched at load

tasks.name: The processor locks and switches
tasks.description: session gains the Shift state; the processor locks the current segment, then switches ascii_mode, on a Shift tap.
acceptance: lua tests/test_session.lua and lua tests/test_processor.lua pass; scripts/run_tests.sh is all PASS
On a tap with a draft open, confirm_current_selection comes before set_option; with no draft only the mode switches
A tap commits nothing and clears nothing; Shift+Enter, Shift+letter, Control+Shift and a hold of 500 ms or more are not taps
With the caret inside the input, the first tap only moves the caret to the end
The Shift state lives in a Context property, survives session.clear() and is per input box
engine:commit_text() still appears only in ime_translate_processor.lua

The built schema has Caps_Lock: noop and no lua_translator

The deploy and a Squirrel restart log no Rime error, and the Step 6 probe shows the literal English in the draft

tasks.name: Enter and Space — the Enter way
tasks.description: decide gains unselected: Enter on unselected pinyin locks it as the letters typed (lock_literal); Space with nothing unselected adds a literal space (literal_space). The processor runs both without switching the mode.
acceptance: lua tests/test_decide.lua and lua tests/test_processor.lua pass; scripts/run_tests.sh is all PASS
Enter in idle with unselected pinyin: what is not confirmed is replaced by one bare segment over it, then confirmed; nothing committed, nothing translated, the mode untouched
Space with no modifier, a draft open and nothing unselected: a space is pushed and confirmed; a translation on screen is voided first; otherwise Space is native
The caret rule covers both actions; Shift+Enter, Esc and the result/error phases are unchanged
engine:commit_text() still appears only in ime_translate_processor.lua; neither action clears the draft
